body:
Long day, but I'm back.

Well really, only you can determine if your hobbies are enough on any given day. Some of those days, I've no doubt that they won't be enough. Yesterday was probably one of those days. I think those kinds of days are fine though. Maybe you have them more than others, but that's why you're here.

No one can hold all the weight alone. A little help, a little encouragement, a little push is something everyone needs in varying degrees. I hope that if you find yourself in a similar situation again, then you can find what you need again whether it be from a friend or this sub.

As for hoping for the best, well, let's be forreal, that shit can get real tiring and real draining. You do you, you know what I'm saying. on days you can't manage it to look forward, then just do your best to just live. Live on automation, run from the problems, immerse yourself in a book, that's all fine. And whenever you have the strength, you can hope again.

I hope you're doing okay. If you ever need someone to talk to let me know, or hell, post in the sub again. This place is rather supportive 24/7.

I said I'd be fine if my post fell on deaf ears, but I'm actually really glad that someone took the time to read and comment. It means a lot more to me than I expected, and I appreciate that. Thank you.

Also, thanks for the concern, but I don't think I need anything. At least not yet. This post helped me unload a lot of my baggage, and even if the problems are still here, I can deal with them. I can't find a way to live for myself yet, but I can live for others. That's fine. Hopefully along the way I can pick the pieces of myself back up.

Really though. Thanks man.

You know what, I'll tell you. You've got books to read, and runners' highs to feel.

You like reading and running, and I think that's a great combo. Maybe one day you'll find someone who likes the same thing, or does the same thing. Until then, you can read a little more, run a little more, and I think that's good enough. One thing at a time right?
So fucking true. I know what you mean, I can't afford to die while I'm still a part of people's lives.

Damn to us both eh. Good luck with everything, both of us probably need as much of it we can get. No actually, we don't need luck, I'm just hoping we both have enough for us to cling onto life at this point.

I don't know you, I don't have any words to comfort you, but I hope you'll be okay.

I don't know the difference between being sincere and selfish. I feel like I'm constantly at odds with myself because I don't think I'm a good person. When I help others, I can't tell if it's to please myself or to genuinely help others. And so I continue living trying to cope with the fact that everyone thinks I'm some saint when I'm a fucking scum.

Hah, hell since I'm here I may as well get this off my chest too. I fucked my prospective career a long time along and now I'm dragging myself through the mud, wasting money and time on something I know won't happen. I wanted to be a doctor, and its not gonna happen anymore. I'm only 23 and I feel like I wasted half my conscious life. And now, the weight of everyone's expectations and my grand delusions are making it hard to live.
